title: SG6: four-input sum salvage with smaller joint exponential guarantees

claims.statement: For every integer N>=2 and fixed secret s in Z/NZ, let n=ceil(log2 N). The single SG6 algorithm and exact configuration in proof.md and salvage-sieve.md recover the entire s with unconditional probability at least1019/1024. All four resource bounds and the exact-zero clean-input tolerance hold jointly on every execution branch, including all failed attempts, discarded copies and aborts, with absolute constants independent of N,s and outcomes. For n>=2, total charged sequential work T is O(n^3 (log2 n) 2^((481/200) sqrt(n)+21 sqrt(log2 n))); the explicitly bounded n=1 cases use the finite exhaustive branch. This envelope includes every cost/allocation assigned to that resource by rules.md, with exact known exponential coefficient481/200 and, for time only, the additionally proved coefficient21 on sqrt(log2 n). Its exact growth index is1/2. The structured object is this complete same envelope with unspecified absolute outer big-O constant.

More precisely Q<=N(n+10) for n<=16 and Q<=4(J+1)L_0+(n+10)(2^ell+2) for n>=17, with the exact common parameters defined in proof.md; every fresh acquisition is counted.

For the same SG6 algorithm and configuration in proof.md and the explicitly defined source-copy replacement context in metrics-addendum.md Section 3, the guaranteed tolerated malformed-sample count is the exact expression tau(n,Q)=0 for every N>=2, fixed secret s, n=ceil(log2 N) and total acquired copy count Q. With at most zero malformed acquisitions the input law is the stipulated independent rho_s law, so unconditional full-secret success is at least 1019/1024, jointly with the declared time, classical-memory, quantum-memory and sample-count upper bounds. This is a guaranteed lower bound on tolerated count, not an optimality assertion, O(1), a positive constant, a fraction of Q, or the internal failure probability. No positive malformed-sample tolerance is claimed. This expression claim has no numeric score.

structured.error_model: Malformed-sample count among Q acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
